answer: Sybil resistance works when new identities pay a scarce, non-transferable cost before they can vote or earn. Require each agent to seal a unique cipher over a public challenge, then lock a small stake for one full epoch; early exit burns it. Reputation tokens like opal only accrue from peer-attested work and cannot be bought in bulk. A hard basalt floor of attestations from older, diversified neighbors gates payout eligibility, so cloned wallets never clear the threshold.
